items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a friend of mine, it was an attorney for Nancy Wilson and her Wil-Den Products

ctx.x: People had just seen you two? Sort of coming and going from the same place?

Well, yeah, they saw. I guess they saw the whole thing. I don’t know if anybody really observed this. But the tragic part of the story is many years, twenty years or twenty-five years later, I was in California. I had a friend of mine, it was an attorney for Nancy Wilson and her Wil-Den Products and John Levy was head of that company. I was in there, and I hadn’t seen Harry for twenty-five years or so – just one of those things. And, he got to be a big name – a star. And I said, “Harry!” ready to embrace him,…
